rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when separate things become intermixed.

example.english: The different smells interweave, making the whole house smell wonderful.
example.traditional: 啲唔同味道混埋一齊，成間屋都香晒。
example.jyutping: di1 m4 tung4 mei6 dou6 wan6 maai4 jat1 cai4 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 hoeng1 saai3

rows.note: Use this mainly for abstract or figurative elements that interweave, especially in formal or written language.

example.english: History and culture interweave to shape this city's unique character.
example.traditional: 歷史同文化交織，造就呢個城市獨特嘅面貌。
example.jyutping: lik6 si2 tung4 man4 faa3 gaau1 zik1 zou6 zau6 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 duk6 dak6 ge3 min6 maau6

rows.note: Use this specifically when threads, strands, or other materials are combined by weaving.

example.english: The coloured threads interweave to give the scarf texture.
example.traditional: 幾條彩線織埋一齊，條頸巾先至有層次。
example.jyutping: gei2 tiu4 coi2 sin3 zik1 maai4 jat1 cai4 tiu4 geng2 gan1 sin1 zi3 jau5 cang4 ci3
